description: Offline behavior of the workflow planner the references document as python3 scripts/orchestrate_kernel.py "<goal>" --json.

cases.behavior: An audit-then-release goal plans the web app audit first and the pinned release gate second, each with its CW-AIP output type.
run: web app audit then release gate for build v2.3 on staging

json.goal_summary: web app audit then release gate for build v2.3 on staging

steps.purpose: Gate pinned RC/build with audit findings

boundaries: Release Readiness requires pinned RC/build + environment.
Audit findings feed gates; score cannot override hard gates.

cases.behavior: Evidence followed by weekly priorities plans evidence verification before the product operator, and keeps prioritization out of the research step.
run: verify evidence then weekly operator priorities

json.goal_summary: verify evidence then weekly operator priorities
boundaries: Evidence Researcher does not prioritize or sequence product work.
Product Operator owns NOW/NEXT/LATER after evidence is admitted.

cases.behavior: A request for one specialist's output only is not turned into a multi-step workflow; it plans that single skill.
run: evidence pack only on the pricing claims

steps.purpose: User requested a single specialist skill

boundaries: Single-skill mode — load only the target SKILL.md.
Re-run orchestrator when the user wants a multi-step workflow.

cases.behavior: A question about which skill to use yields a routing recommendation with no execution steps.
run: which skill should I use for this?

boundaries: Emit routing recommendation only — do not execute domain skills in this turn unless user confirms.

cases.behavior: A broad orchestration goal with no decision, roadmap or release in it is pruned to the evidence step only.
run: orchestrate a full workflow for the checkout launch

cases.behavior: An empty goal is rejected with a usage error instead of producing a plan.
Without --json the planner prints the archetype, numbered steps with their output types and the boundaries in plain text.
run: web app audit then release gate for build v2.3 on staging

stdout_contains: 1. web-app-auditor: Produce findings with evidence → FindingEnvelope
2. release-readiness: Gate pinned RC/build with audit findings → DecisionHandoff
boundary: Release Readiness requires pinned RC/build + environment.
